newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Jinzhou Harbour plans A, B share IPOs.
newsitem.headline: China Jinzhou Harbour plans A, B share IPOs.

text.p: China's Jinzhou Harbour Group Co Ltd plans to make an initial public offering of 100 million foreign currency B shares for listing in Shanghai, a company official said on Tuesday.
The port operator will also offer 60 million domestic currency A shares after floating the foreign currency B shares, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.

The Shanghai securities authorities have agreed to the listing, which still requires final approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), the national securities watchdog, the official said.

The Jinzhou company, based in the northern province of Liaoning, has appointed Guangdong Guangfa Securities Co Ltd as the lead domestic underwriter for the A and B share offers, he said. He declined to give further details.
